parsed.note_claim: Hamam / Hammam (همّام) is an Arabic male given name meaning someone energetic, determined, courageous, or ambitious.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: معنى .. "هَمّام": اسم علم مذكر عربي، بصيغة المبالغة. معناه: المقدام، صاحب الهمة، الماضي العزيمة، النمّام.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly defines Hamam as an Arabic male name and lists meanings such as courageous and ambitious that directly match the note's claims.
